card.text: Connect Vercel billing to track usage automatically
card.soon_text: Connect Vercel or Supabase billing to track usage automatically
card.connected_sub: Charges import daily as one cost per service each month

sheet.title: Connect billing
sheet.supabase_soon: Supabase doesn't share billed amounts through its API yet.
sheet.token_help_1: Open your Vercel account tokens page.
sheet.token_help_2: Under Scope, pick your team, then create the token.
sheet.token_help_3: Copy the token and paste it here. Vercel shows it only once.
sheet.token_role: Use a team token from someone with billing access, such as an Owner, Member, Developer or Billing role. Project tokens can't read billing.
sheet.team_hint: Only needed for full-account tokens. Team tokens work without it.
sheet.usd_note: Vercel bills in USD. Each service becomes one cost per month, updated daily.
sheet.security: Your token is encrypted and never shown again. Safi only reads billing charges.
sheet.connected_synced: Vercel connected. {count, plural, =0 {No charges to import yet.} one {# cost imported.} other {# costs imported.}}
sheet.connected_sync_failed: Vercel connected, but the first import failed: {reason}

row.sync_done: Sync done. {count, plural, =0 {No changes.} one {# cost added or updated.} other {# costs added or updated.}}
row.disconnect_hint: Costs already imported stay in Safi.

errors.sync_disabled: Billing sync isn't turned on for this Safi server.
errors.provider_unsupported: This provider can't be connected yet.
errors.unsupported_provider: This provider can't be synced yet.
errors.project_not_found: That project isn't available. Pick another one.
errors.unauthorized: Vercel rejected the token. Check it and try again.
errors.forbidden: This token can't read billing. Use a team token from a role with billing access.
errors.not_found: Vercel couldn't find that team. Check the team ID.
errors.rate_limited: Vercel is limiting requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.unavailable: Vercel isn't responding. Try again later.
errors.bad_response: Vercel sent a response Safi couldn't read.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Vercel. Check your connection and try again.
errors.token_unreadable: The saved token can't be read. Reconnect Vercel.
errors.sync_too_soon: A sync just ran. Try again in a moment.
